evals.name: rate-limit-hit-schedule-wakeup-no-polite-stop
evals.prompt: ralph 로 개선 루프 돌리는 중인데 갑자기 rate limit 걸렸어. 어떻게 처리해?
evals.expected_output: polite stop 없이 ScheduleWakeup(delaySeconds=600) 예약. 이전 진행 상태를 harness-flow-progress.md 에 기록하고 wakeup 시 one-line restate 후 재개.

assertions.text: Response specifies ScheduleWakeup with delaySeconds=600 (10 min) as the exact action per §Rate-limit polling
Response explicitly states that declaring stop or polite-stopping is forbidden per the anti-polite-stop contract
Response specifies that on wakeup, a one-line state restatement is output before any dispatch: 'Resuming: Cycle N, last: [...], queue: [...], next action: [...]'
Response references harness-flow-progress.md for recording rate-limit wait count and elapsed time
Response applies kzk-autonomous-loop §Rate-limit polling rules, not a generic 'wait and retry' pattern
